topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture, links it to previous practical work, and outlines the session's learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Identification of Transforming Oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental assays for cellular transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, Tumor Suppressor Genes, and Mutation Phenotypes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the mechanistic classifications of cancer genes and illustrate how dominant, recessive, and dominant-negative mutations disrupt cell cycle control.

topics.label: Forms, Mechanisms, and Progression of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how specific defects in DNA repair, replication, and mitotic chromosome segregation cause sequence or chromosomal instability during multistep tumorigenesis.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition Syndromes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inherited germline mutations accelerate cancer development and influence tumor evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer closes the session, provides a recommended reading resource, and previews the next lecture.
